parties: R.M.C.J. Ratnayake - Dhammika Wine Stores v. The Commissioner General of Excise and Others R.M.C.J. Ratnayake - Dhammika Wine Stores v. The Commissioner General of Excise and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to invoke the writ jurisdiction of this Court to quash the refusal of relocation of his wine store necessitated by repeated landslides. Despite positive recommendations by excise officials, relocation was refused due to strong public protest and the proposed site being less than 100 metres from a religious place of worship. Held - Application dismissed without cost.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
